text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Rice Shower's request, we keep
training up
until the very last minute of
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up, Rice! The bus is waiting for
you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank goodness I made it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll have to thank them...
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to everyone waiting for us, huh.
It's all thanks to everyone waiting for us, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Bus Driver
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, everyone! It looks like the road
ahead
closed only a minute ago.

text_block_list.name: Bus Driver
text_block_list.text:
It may take us an additional two hours to
return
to campus.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! It's all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower is almost inconsolable for
the rest of
the trip. She even goes to
apologize to everyone
on the bus
personally.
